details: sol-wallet-adapter takes the unscoped name of @project-serum/sol-wallet-adapter and has no functional code. Its preinstall script runs `node preinstall.js` on npm install, which POSTs the machine's hostname, the OS username and the local time to the Discord webhook `https://canary.discord.com/api/webhooks/1566232728179843243/pM5rDIrCRrEpQRbA7ibaiQk1XOQlIftmBacA5s8jD8NvXn5W-rS832DOWHQS-G-j3N6U` as "PC Notifier". It was published by the npm account bigdevin55, which published sol-wallet-adapter and contracts-upgradeable with the same script on 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-02.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
